title.en: Chapter 6: The Light in the Box

text.zh_HK: 四段路行完，返到2027年。條街冇變——但你看佢嘅眼神唔同晒喇。
text.zh_CN: 四段路走完，回到2027年。街道没变——但你看着它的眼神完全不同了。
text.en: Four journeys done, and you are back in 2027. The street has not changed — the way you look at it has.

text.zh_HK: 個箱喺你腳邊打開，每件嘢都喺度輕輕嗡緊，好似等緊你講佢哋嘅故事。
text.zh_CN: 箱子在你脚边打开，每件东西都在轻轻嗡鸣，像在等你讲出它们的故事。
text.en: The box opens at your feet; every keepsake hums softly, waiting for its story to be told.
Finish the last page with Mrs Chan.

text.zh_HK: 個箱唔使搬走——街坊一齊喺舖頭門口搭咗個小小嘅回憶角：茶罐、票根、行李牌、嗰封信，一邊一個位，配一句佢嘅故事。
text.zh_CN: 箱子不用搬走——街坊一起在铺子门口搭了个小小的回忆角：茶罐、票根、行李牌、那封信，一边一个位，配一句它的故事。
text.en: The box does not have to go anywhere — the street builds a little memory corner by the shop: the tea tin, the ticket stubs, the luggage tag, the letter, each with its place and one line of its story.

text.zh_HK: 阿明掛上一串燈籠，陳太沖咗奶茶，根叔隻雀仔唱咗成個下晝。《香港故事》——多謝你陪呢條街行完呢段路。
text.zh_CN: 阿明挂上一串灯笼，陈太冲了奶茶，根叔的鸟唱了一整个下午。《香港故事》——谢谢你陪这条街走完这段路。
text.en: Ming strings up lanterns, Mrs Chan brews the milk tea, and Ken's bird sings all afternoon. HONG KONG STORIES — thank you for walking this street with us.

_comment: Chapter-6 finale (PLAN §12.2: deliver the last story, decide what the box is for) — the bookend on chapter-1's street, cute and warm. Triggered by the box in the flat after all four journeys. The resolution is a street memory corner: the mementos stay where their stories live.
